title: Barangay Directory
description: Schema for component barangay unit data. Fields that have not been verified against a civic source are null or empty, never invented or filled with placeholder text.

slug.description: URL segment. Lowercase, hyphen-separated, derived from the PSGC name.

barangay_name.description: Official name as published in the PSGC, cased ready to render.

name_variants.description: Alternative spellings observed on other authoritative sources.

population_2024_popcen.description: 2024 Census of Population count published by the PSA.

address.description: Null until an authoritative address is sourced.

trunkline.description: Empty until an authoritative contact number is sourced.

website.description: Null until an authoritative page is sourced.

officials.description: One entry per elective seat: the Punong Barangay and the Sangguniang Kabataan Chairperson, in that order. The seat is published whoever holds it; a name appears only when two independent source families name the same person in that seat, and is never filled from a superseded term.

role.description: The title of the seat, e.g. "Punong Barangay".

name_status.description: Why the name is or is not published. `published` requires a name and at least two sources. `conflicting_sources`: sources name different people. `uncorroborated`: fewer than two independent source families name anyone. Both withheld states require name to be null and sources to be empty.

name.description: The holder as the city's roster prints it, without honorifics. Render verbatim.

term.description: Term of the seat, e.g. "2023–2028". A fact about the seat, so it is stated even when the holder is withheld. Null unless term_sources establish it.

term_sources.description: Civic-source ids establishing the term: the laws and election-body issuances it follows from.

sources.description: Civic-source ids naming this person in this seat. At least two, from at least two independent source families; the provenance test enforces the independence. Empty when the name is withheld.
